title: Curation + RBAC policy for golden prompt datasets and versioned registries
creator: Maya Lopez
description: Problem: We lack a single authoritative registry for golden prompt sets used by automated evals and regression checks. Teams manually copy prompt lists into repos or dashboards, causing drift, permission sprawl, and silent regressions when config/model changes occur. Goal: Build a curated, versioned golden promptset registry with role-based access controls, explicit curation workflows, audit trails, and hooks for eval pipelines so regression alerts tie back to the exact promptset + model/config version that produced the result.
scope: Design and implement a golden promptset registry (store metadata + canonical prompts)
Support semantic versions for promptsets and immutable snapshots used in eval runs
RBAC model: curator, reviewer, consumer, and auditor roles with CTX-scoped access (org/project)
Integration points: Redwood Optimize eval runner, Console dashboards (rollouts & regression alerts), and API for programmatic retrieval
Audit logs for create/update/delete/approve events and linkage to eval runs
out_of_scope: Automatic synthetic prompt generation (outside curation flow)
Model training data lineage beyond model id + config
Full UI polish for console (we'll deliver functional UX first)
acceptance_criteria: Create API endpoints to create/preview/publish promptset snapshots with metadata (owner, changelog, tags, version)
Implement RBAC enforcement such that only curators can publish and reviewers can approve; consumers can fetch published snapshots without elevated privileges
Eval runner records promptset_id:version and model_id:config_hash in every regression alert and stores permalink to the snapshot
Console shows a promptset lineage view with versions, approvals, and linked eval failures (click-through to example prompts and model outputs)
Audit log searchable by promptset_id, user, and time range; retain 13 months by default
design_decisions: Storage: canonical prompts stored as newline-delimited JSONL blob in object storage with metadata in registry DB (small index table)
Versioning: semantic versioning with immutable snapshots; 'draft' -> 'staged' -> 'published' lifecycle
Access model: map existing IAM groups to roles; provide an API token scope for service accounts used by CI/eval runners
Schema: each prompt item includes id, text, expected_labels (optional), tags, and example_outputs to enable structured evals
Rollback: publish creates immutable snapshot; new publish creates new version; admins can deprecate but not delete published snapshots without an approval workflow
implementation_notes: Backend: registry microservice with endpoints: POST /promptsets, GET /promptsets/{id}/versions/{v}, POST /promptsets/{id}/versions/{v}/approve
Auth: reuse Redwood SSO + org/project scoping; service token scope for eval runners to fetch published snapshots
Eval integration: modify Optimize eval runner to include promptset_version in run metadata and include sample outputs in regression payload
Console: surface preview widget with diff view between versions and example failing prompts linked to regression alerts
Migration: script to ingest existing curated lists (PRD + eval harness lists) with provenance fields
risks_and_mitigation: Risk: teams might bypass registry to iterate quickly -> Mitigation: provide a frictionless API + CI-friendly workflow and documentation; soft quota on external copies
Risk: large promptsets causing storage/transfer costs -> Mitigation: enforce per-prompt length limits, compress JSONL, and offer deduplication by hash
Risk: accidental deletion of published golden sets -> Mitigation: soft delete + approval required for purge, 30-day retention window
rollout_plan: Phase 1 (MVP) - 4 weeks: API, DB, object storage snapshots, RBAC enforcement, basic Console view, eval runner hook (metadata only)
Phase 2 - 6 weeks: approval workflows, publish notifications, audit log UI, version diff and example output linking
Phase 3 - 4 weeks: migration script, org-wide training, instrument regression dashboards to link back to promptset versions and responsible owners
metrics: Percent of eval/regression alerts that include a promptset_version (target 100% after Phase 1)
Time-to-publish (curation cycle) measured from draft -> published (target median < 48h)
Number of external copies of golden sets per org (aim to reduce by 70% in 3 months)
Mean time to triage a regression with linked promptset (target < 2 hours for P0/P1)
